steps.content:
7:00 p.m., January 23, N.F. 113
West bank of the Rust - My Best Cool Car parking spot

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Hi everyone! It's finally Love's turn to do the vlog. How about it? Doesn't it feel all fresh and new?

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Or maybe, the site is already chock full of my old fans?

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: This is for an Eastside vlog site. Syndicans who don't use the Internet won't be visiting it. You should start over.

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Also, this isn't the radio station. Don't bring out your old habits. Be good and tell everyone about the crew's progress today.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: <size=28>Think you're cool just because you're holding the camera? You're bringing out your old habit of dissing me, too...</size>

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Ah, never mind, never mind... In any case, since Director D joined, recruitment has ended. The film crew has officially been established!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: OwO is getting special training from the director, and also working on the script. Us three production staff went around all the studios in Dillywood last night and learned a lot. We also bought almost everything we need.

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Actually, we didn't buy much, mainly because of limited funds. We emptied the little clapper's wallet.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Ahaha, that's what investment is! Tomorrow we'll start shooting, so the workload will increase a lot. We'll get the real sense of filmmaking in no time!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: And tonight, the crew needs to do something very important! That is...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: That is...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: ...Why aren't you dissing me? The ratings are gonna drop.

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: You weren't planning to say it tonight anyways. Weren't you saving it as a surprise for tomorrow?

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Even though I don't think you'll finish in one night...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: O ho ho ho, don't underestimate my knack for fun. In any case, get ready for the official shoot tomorrow!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Next up, let's turn our camera to the director, and take a peek at how the script is coming along...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Lynn! We're giving the camera to you. You're the best at sneaking up on people and observing them! Be careful not to let them notice you!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Eek! I... I can't!

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Sigh...

steps.speaker: [Scene Change]
steps.content: Inside the vehicle

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I... can't... figure... it... out!!!
She runs around the vehicle with the script on her head.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Director D, Director D, Director D, help help, help...

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Whoaaaa!
The best Lion Dancing Queen in the whole wide world jumps onto the dozing director, startling her so much that she falls off the hammock and lands on her face.
After delegating work to everyone else, the director had been sleeping till now.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Tomorrow we'll start shooting. Come and pick a script! All of them are great, so I can't decide. You do it, you're the expert from Dillywood.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Once you pick it, I'll add in a part about lion dancing, and then we'll just wait for the DisCars.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Phew... Let me see...

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Tales of Courage... Once Upon a Time in Syndicate... Super Lion vs. Starzilla... Hmm...

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: All three stories are great. Why don't we film one every year, and get all the DisCars for the next three years.
She starts to brag with her eyes barely open.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Really? I knew it!
So there are people who'll believe it.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: I can draw lots and pick one, but don't you want to make the one about sending Stella home the most?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Mmm...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Umm... That one's not good enough. I'm not satisfied with it, so I don't want to film it... It's better to pick from these three...

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: You don't need someone else to pick the story you want to tell the most.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: And it's precisely because it's your favorite story, that's why you're dissatisfied and want to improve it, right?
OwO falls silent.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But I don't know how to end it...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It's a story about sending Stella home, but in the end, I can't think of a way to have them reunite. No matter how hard I try, the ending comes off fake and hard to believe.
She whines, tugging D's sleeve with her little hand.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: A director called Deren once said she could turn falsehoods into truths and have everyone believe it. She says that's the power of a director.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Do you have that kind of power, D? Can you teach me some techniques?
D smiles and rubs OwO's head.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: You don't need to learn that, OwO. Those are for tricking people. Directors are constantly lying. They trick their audiences all the way till the movie ends and the lights come on.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: All the lies are meant to bring people to the one and only truth. It's your job to find it.
She points at OwO's heart.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: This is OwO's story. Only you can find the ending.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Only me... But how do I do that? I don't understand.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: No worries. If you're running short on inspiration, then spring into action. Go outside and look around.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Don't think too hard. Listen to your heart's desires as you experience the world. Stories are ever-changing desires. You have to immerse yourself in them to find their endpoint.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: To put it simply, just brush it aside and get some sleep first. Tomorrow you can think and film at the same time.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Come. Stop carrying around that script you're stuck on and hug Stella instead. Sleep on it. Maybe you'll find something in your dreams.
She picks up the little critter from the ground and puts it into OwO's arms. She then picks up the girl, places her in the hammock, and whispers to her.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: The director is actually quite a gentle soul... Right, ${PlayerName}?
She turns and says this to you.

steps.speaker: Option
options: ...Love and Daisy need your help. Leave the things here to me.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Sigh... Does that mean My Best Cool Car is... Oops! I almost gave it away.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: All right, then. I'll leave the filming to you. I'll go now.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Thank you!
She gives the phone she's filming with to you, bows, and hurries away.

steps.speaker: [End vlog]
steps.content: Black Screen

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Director, can we talk?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Oh my... Quit staring, it's freaking me out... I'll go, I'll go... The second round of interviews, right?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: I'm still a bit sleep-deprived. If I don't do that well, please bear with me... Hehe...

steps.speaker: [Scene Change]
steps.content: By the Rust
You flip through Love's shopping list while Deren looks at you innocently.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Snacks, icebox, voice recorder, inspiration log, parasols, sunglasses, baseball caps, umbrellas, raincoats, cough drops, power banks, exclusive Deadlover Radio drawing paper...

steps.speaker: Option
options: I hear these are outdoor shooting props that you requested, Director.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Yes, that's right. I found these items to be quite useful for my past crews.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: After looking through the list, I noticed that you didn't include audio equipment, camera sliders or any other filming equipment.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're not going to make us film with our phones, are you?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Ahaha... Well, occasionally, low-budget movies stand out, too. They can have quite the mood and feel.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Plus, it's OwO's thought that counts. I'm trying hard to help her improve the script.

steps.speaker: Option
options: All I see is you being an opportunist and tricking her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In the end, it's still all about getting OwO to think for herself. What have you done aside from sleeping?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Wow, what a mean clapper... What kind of director do you want...?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Someone who'll just hand you a DisCar? You want a big Dillywood director?
She tilts her head, grinning at you while squinting her eyes. You can't decipher the expression in her eyes, but she gives off a familiar feel.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: OwO's desire for the DisCars is different from yours. I don't care what's your real reason for joining, nor do I care if we'll actually succeed in the end. But during this process, please don't hurt her.
Smiling, she holds up her head and looks at you for so long that you thought she fell asleep standing up again. Just as you're about to say something, she speaks...

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Hehe... What a rookie actor...

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Did you forget your own script after staying with her for too long? Or is it because you've become too attached and feel confused about your role?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Why don't I help you look over the script?
She turns to you slowly, grinning goofily. Her squinted eyes don't reveal a hint of sincerity. For a moment, you're shaken, while she's already next to your ear, whispering softly.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Need me to give you some pointers?
In this moment, you feel goosebumps all over your body. The memory of the Dean grabbing your arm flashes through your mind... No, it feels even scarier than that.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Hehe... I'm just joking. I don't get it, and it's already late. It'd be awful if the paparazzi catches the two of us whispering outside.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: I'm going back now. Come on time tomorrow. Filming outside is hard work...
She puts on her innocent look again, yawns, waves her hand, and goes back.
